title: Jig Template Manifest
description: Template manifest (jig.json). Declares the variables a template prompts for: default, prompt text, and a validation pattern per variable. PROJECT_NAME is required (validated by jig, not expressible here).

version.description: File-format version. Always 1 for this schema.

variables.description: Template variables by name. Every variable declares a default; prompt text and a validation pattern are optional.

default.description: Value used when the user does not override it.

prompt.description: Prompt text shown in interactive mode.

pattern.description: Regex the final value must match (RE2 syntax). Mutually exclusive with choices.

choices.description: Fixed set of allowed values. Mutually exclusive with pattern; the default must be one of them.

verbatim.description: Directory base names whose subtrees are copied verbatim: names and contents are NOT rendered, wherever the directory sits in the skeleton. For templates that ship templates (e.g. a type's embedded template/ dir).
